text:
Maya: starting onboarding for zeta-13b-lite. need final weights location + perms check before we mirror from HF. hf repo says redwood/zeta-13b-lite but target is s3://rw-weights/staging/zeta-13b-lite/v1 — who owns the prefix?
Simon: @Maya I own that prefix. IAM uses rw-ingest-service and rw-sre-batch. do you need a presign window longer than 1h?
Maya: for CI 1h is fine, but registry presigns need 24h for warm re-syncs. can we add short-lived role assumption? also i tried a quick copy: ```aws s3 cp s3://rw-weights/staging/zeta-13b-lite/v1/pytorch_model.bin ./ --no-sign-request``` and got 403.
Olivia: don't use --no-sign-request there — that bypasses auth. 403 usually means an IAM deny. @Simon can you confirm bucket policy allows the ingest role to read that prefix?
IngestBot: Artifact mirror job queued: mirror-job-2770012345 started -> src=hf://redwood/zeta-13b-lite, dst=s3://rw-weights/staging/zeta-13b-lite/v1
Kai: quick heads-up: tokenizer has odd pad_id ordering for this checkpoint — tokenizer_config.json shows "padding_side": "left" but pad token id isn't 0; our smoke eval failed. @Maya can you attach tokenizer files?
Maya: manifest snippet: ```manifest:
 - s3://rw-weights/staging/zeta-13b-lite/v1/tokenizer.json
 - s3://rw-weights/staging/zeta-13b-lite/v1/tokenizer_config.json
sha256: 3a7f...9b2``` (shortened)
Simon: i pulled the manifest, object exists. looks like you need sts:AssumeRole to rw-ingest-deployer to get s3:GetObject on that prefix. i'll add a temp policy and post ARN.
Maya: thanks. also mirror checksum mismatch: HF sha256 3a7f...9b2 but mirror shows 3a7f...9b3 — could be transfer compression. @Kai any tokenizer impact?
Kai: if the bin got gzipped during transfer our KV cache != persisted bytes -> mismatch. suggest re-run mirror with `--no-compress` and validate with: `aws s3api head-object --bucket rw-weights --key staging/zeta-13b-lite/v1/pytorch_model.bin --query ChecksumSHA256` then compare.
SREBot: Deploy pipeline: mirror-job-2770012345 failed step 3 (verify-checksum). Retry queued.
Olivia: i'll coordinate with infra to unblock the role. @Simon pls drop the role ARN here. Maya, leave retry to the job — it will pick up new policy once applied.
Maya: ping @Simon when done, trying to unblock canary pin to v1. also adding a tiny smoke prompt: "Summarize the release notes in 3 bullets." helps check padding.
Simon: Role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rw-ingest-deployer-temp-2770012345 — added inline policy allowing s3:GetObject on staging prefix for 1h. retrying mirror.
IngestBot: mirror-job-2770012345 retry started -> attempting transfer with --no-compress
Maya: mirror succeeded, checksum now matches 3a7f...9b2. tokenizer padding fixed by swapping pad token id in tokenizer_config.json (0 -> 1). running smoke eval.
Kai: smoke eval passed with padding fix. :tada: 
Olivia: thanks team. next: update onboarding checklist PR and add note about presign TTLs and compressor flags.
Maya: PR created: https://git.redwood.com/rw/weights-registry/pull/512 — @Olivia @Simon PTAL when you can.
